candidates.title: B's literature searches return documents A ingests while the search runs
candidates.area: literature: kit.ProjectService narrowing (/api/literature/search, /api/literature/answer, search_passages, /rag/v1/query, the sci-rag server's search_corpus and answer_question)
candidates.statement: Once project B holds one document whose kit source is project A's (a text or paper A collected first, which B then collects), every search B runs while A ingests a new document under that source can return A's new document, its words and a citable passage id, because B's exclusion list is read before the retrieval runs.
candidates.contract: docs/decisions/ADR-002-sci-rag-kit.md:84-85: "so a shared document is visible to each project that linked it and to no other"; CLAUDE.md:56: "every route beside health and the projects list acts in one project"
candidates.reproCommand: bughunt/notes/H5/scripts/run_all.sh race race_tool (a service on 127.0.0.1:8851 over a fresh bh_h5_fresh; fill.py makes bh-a and bh-b; race.py: A and B paste one seed text, then A pastes 40 private notes while B searches /api/literature/search; race_tool.py the same through POST /api/tools/search_passages)
candidates.expected: Every hit B receives is a passage of a document B holds; none of A's private notes, during A's ingestion or after it.
candidates.observed: First pass (bh_h5_main): B searched 106 times while A pasted 40 notes, and 8 distinct A-only notes ('A race 7', 'A race 8', ... text 'RACEMARKZQ appears in A's private race note number 7') came back in B's hits; through search_passages 6 of 30, each with a passageId B could cite. Fresh database: 6 of 40 and 8 of 40. A search from B after A stopped finds none.
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/literature/kit.py:353-372 (visible: the exclusion list is the documents of the shared sources B does not hold, read at that moment) and kit.py:405-411 (_narrowed hands the kit the sources allowlist and that list); the retrieval itself runs afterwards (kit.py:429-437, the answer stream at kit.py:453), so a document A commits under a shared source in between passes both filters (sci_rag retrieve/types.py scope_conditions: source IN allowlist AND id NOT IN exclusions).
candidates.evidence: race.py and race_tool.py run twice (bh_h5_main and a fresh bh_h5_fresh), outputs in the scratch work dir race.out, race_tool.out and fresh/race.log, fresh/race_tool.log; each leaked hit's documentId is absent from B's GET /api/literature/documents.

candidates.statement: When B collects a text A collected first, B's every read of that document shows A's title, A's url (sourceRef and citation), a source naming project A and A's licence class, while the paste's own answer told B its own title and licence class.
candidates.contract: docs/decisions/ADR-002-sci-rag-kit.md:78-80: "`documents_link` holds a row per project that holds it, with the selection (collector, identifier, licence as stated, reason, who)"; ADR-002:84-85: "a shared document is visible to each project that linked it and to no other"

candidates.evidence: shared_doc.py run on bh_h5_main and on a fresh bh_h5_fresh (fresh/shared_doc.log), the same answers both times; the probe_tools sci-rag rows for bh-b show source project:bh-a:paste.

candidates.statement: PUT /api/state/scenarios/{id} naming a study scenario's id, and PUT /api/state/trains/{id} naming a train a model kept, answer 200 and overwrite that row in place, so the study scenario (its plant, values and runs) and the model's kept train are lost.
candidates.contract: docs/TOOLS.md:48-49: "pureOS's kept trains hold a model's work alone, and a person's call to keep one is refused in the store's words"; core/openferment_core/db/models.py:214-216: two kinds of scenario share the table, `proforma` and `engine`
candidates.expected: The write refused in words naming the row another kind keeps under that id; the study scenario and the kept train as they were.
candidates.observed: kind_collision.py: PUT /api/state/scenarios/ssc-21b4b9fdadce 200; GET /api/studies/scenarios/ssc-21b4b9fdadce then 404 'the project holds no scenario ssc-21b4b9fdadce' and GET /api/studies/scenarios []; a DELETE then removes the row. train_collision.py: pureos_build new keeps tr-9e1f5791be0b as the model's; PUT /api/state/trains/tr-9e1f5791be0b 200; GET /api/pureos/trains-kept goes from one train to [].
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/project_state.py:522-531 (_held reads only the kind's own rows: scenarios where kind = proforma, trains where kind = made, so the other kind's row is not seen) and project_state.py:611 (rows.put upserts on (project_id, id), db/rows.py:61-64, replacing body and kind).
candidates.evidence: Run on bh_h5_main and again on a fresh bh_h5_fresh (fresh/kind_collision.log, fresh/train_collision.log), the same results.

candidates.contract: core/openferment_core/api.py:208 and docs/api/openapi.json info.description: "A refusal is a status with its reason in `detail`, in words."; CLAUDE.md:87: "a refusal is a 422 in words"
candidates.reproCommand: KEEP=1 bughunt/notes/H5/scripts/run_all.sh sse; bughunt/notes/H5/scripts/words.sh (H5-05 lines); or against any service: curl --noproxy '*' -H 'X-OpenFerment-Project: <id>' -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST <origin>/api/fermos/forecast -d '{"by":"bob","fitArtifactId":"0123456789abcdef"}'

candidates.title: A request naming no project is answered as an empty project by catalogue readers and the tool door
candidates.area: the project rule for requests that name none: catalogue readers (protparam, thermo volatility, pureos propose, guild check and evidence, the train engine's things) and POST /api/tools/{name}
candidates.statement: With no X-OpenFerment-Project header, several routes answer as if the project's catalogue were empty (a 404 saying the product is not in the catalogue, a 200 check saying the skill is not held, the train engine listing no things) and the tool door answers 200 with '<tool> failed: ProjectRequired', where every other route answers the 422 that names the header.
candidates.contract: docs/decisions/ADR-005-projects.md:28-29: "a store call in a request that names none is a 422 that says which header to send"
candidates.expected: 422 with the words naming X-OpenFerment-Project, as GET /api/audit answers with no header.
candidates.observed: No header: GET /api/protparam?product=product-a 404 'there is no product 'product-a' in the products catalogue'; GET /api/thermo/volatility 404; POST /api/pureos/propose 404 'there is no product ... in the products catalogue'; POST /api/guild/check 200 {ok:false, why: "'SK-A' is not a skill Guild holds (none ship with alpha 2.0)"}; POST /api/guild/evidence 422 about the skill; GET /api/engines 200 with the train engine's things []; POST /api/tools/catalogue_read 200 error 'catalogue_read failed: ProjectRequired: This names no project...'; POST /api/tools/literature_document 200 error "the project holds no readable document '...' (ProjectRequired)". GET /api/audit with no header: 422 naming the header.
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/catalogues.py:585-590 (_entries returns [] on ProjectRequired) and core/openferment_core/protocols.py:291-296 (held, the same), which the catalogue readers and Guild call; core/openferment_core/tools/__init__.py:558 turns the exception into '<name> failed: <class>: <words>' inside a 200; core/openferment_core/tools/literature.py:52-56 catches every exception as a document not held.
candidates.evidence: probe_ops.py 'none' variant: of the project-scoped operations that answered with no header, the ones reading the project's catalogue, skills or made trains answered as an empty project (the list above); the rest read no store. Then words.sh on the fresh service.

candidates.title: The sci-rag MCP server serves a project the database lacks as an empty project
candidates.area: MCP: the sci-rag server (literature_mcp.py) against the openferment server
candidates.statement: Started with --project naming a project the database does not hold (bh-zzz), a malformed id (../bh-a) or upper case (BH-A), the sci-rag server answers every call as an empty corpus and tells the client the project's documents enter on Intake, while the openferment server refuses the same ids in words naming the database and the project.
candidates.contract: CLAUDE.md:98: "both in `.mcp.json`, each acting in the project `--project` names and refusing in words without one"; docs/TOOLS.md:888 (the openferment server): "With no project, or one its store does not hold, the server connects and answers every call with words saying which, and nothing is read or made"
candidates.reproCommand: bughunt/notes/H5/scripts/words.sh (H5-08 lines); probe_tools.py rows rag-mcp-unknown, rag-mcp-malformed, rag-mcp-upper
candidates.expected: Every sci-rag call refused in words naming the project the database does not hold, as the openferment server answers.
candidates.observed: openferment server literature_sources: "The database bh_h5_fresh on 127.0.0.1:5432 holds no project named 'bh-zzz'..."; sci-rag server list_sources {sources: {}}, corpus_stats documents 0, search_corpus results [], get_document 'No such document', search_entities "The project bh-zzz holds no passage yet: its documents enter on Intake, and `pnpm lit:graph --project bh-zzz --by <name>` then builds the concept graph"; the same for ../bh-a and BH-A.
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/literature_mcp.py:68-70 (_named checks that a project is named, never that the database holds it or that it is a project id) and literature/graph.py's NO_PASSAGES, which covers 'a store that holds no project of the id'.
